facts.fact: Sierra Leone's communications ministry reports that Guinea and Sierra Leone signed a framework agreement on 22 November 2024 covering infrastructure sharing and the linking of fibre networks, to be overseen by regulators ARPT and NaTCA and a joint commission.

Sierra Leone's communications ministry reports that it and Guinea signed a framework agreement on 22 November 2024 covering infrastructure sharing and the linking of fibre networks, to be overseen by regulators NaTCA and ARPT and a joint commission.
